title: Using Environment Variables for DATABASE_URL
description: Configure DATABASE_URL and other Prisma environment variables securely in Next.js.

data.text: Prisma reads the database connection URL from environment variables. In Next.js, environment variables are loaded at build time and runtime, and you must ensure they are available in the correct contexts.

items: **.env** — Default environment variables (committed to version control with placeholder values)
**.env.production** — Production environment variables (set in hosting platform)

data.text: In Next.js, variables prefixed with `NEXT_PUBLIC_` are exposed to the browser. Never prefix `DATABASE_URL` with `NEXT_PUBLIC_` — it should only be available on the server.

data.title: Using DATABASE_URL in Next.js
data.content: Access DATABASE_URL in Prisma and server-side code.

data.title: Security
data.text: Never commit real database credentials to version control. Use environment variables managed by your hosting platform or a secrets manager.
